name: Transgender Congruence Scale (TCS)
directions: Indicate how strongly you agree or disagree with each statement.

questions.text: My outward appearance represents my gender identity.
I experience a sense of unity between my gender identity and my body.
My physical appearance adequately expresses my gender identity.
I am generally comfortable with how others perceive my gender identity when they look at me.
My physical body represents my gender identity.
The way my body currently looks does not represent my gender identity.
I am happy with the way my appearance expresses my gender identity.
I do not feel that my appearance reflects my gender identity.
I feel that my mind and body are consistent with one another.
I am not proud of my gender identity.
I am happy that I have the gender identity that I do.
I have accepted my gender identity.

interpretationNote: The original procedure averages items; scores here are sums. Reverse-coded items are marked. Higher means indicate greater congruence/acceptance.
